output.one_liner: Ramp is a corporate financial management platform providing expense management, bill payment, card controls, and accounting integration with admin-level financial oversight.

auth.notes: Custom OAuth app registration required in Ramp; no Composio-managed OAuth available. Requires organization Owner or Admin access to register OAuth apps.

evidence.snippet: Ramp has no Composio-managed app, so you register your own OAuth app in Ramp and use its credentials in the auth config.
Under **Grant types**, turn on **Authorization code**, **Client credentials**, and **Refresh token**.

access.notes: Organization owner/admin must grant Developer page access to register OAuth apps; demo environment available at demo.ramp.com.

evidence.snippet: You need **Owner** or **Admin** access in Ramp to see the **Developer** page.
read and write scopes across accounting, bills, cards, departments, limits, locations, memos, purchase orders, receipts, spend programs, users, and vendors
